problem: An exact CDC 2.11.2 package subtree passed validate_package.py in a real consumer, but its full 866-test vendored suite failed because test_v2110_guidance.py reads fault-injection/scenarios.json outside the package using ROOT.parent.parent. In canonical g-cdc that path reaches the repository root; under .agents/skills/continuous-development-cycle it reaches .agents/, where the fixture is not part of the released package.

hypotheses.statement: The consumer copied an incomplete or modified CDC package.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compute the vendored .agents/skills/continuous-development-cycle subtree and compare it with the released 2.11.2 package tree; run the package validator.
hypotheses.observed_result: The subtree was exactly 7a7a7faa75b7fc9160d912d8fb507c6b9573d17f and validate_package.py passed: continuous-development-cycle 2.11.2, 316 files and parsed templates.

hypotheses.statement: The failure is caused by a consumer-specific Python/runtime difference.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect the failing traceback and the test's fixture resolution expression rather than the Python runtime.
hypotheses.observed_result: The sole error is deterministic FileNotFoundError for .agents/fault-injection/scenarios.json, produced by ROOT.parent.parent from the vendored package path; 865 other tests passed under the same runtime.

hypotheses.statement: A released package test depends on a canonical-repository fixture that is outside the package transport boundary, so the test suite is not self-contained under vendoring.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Evaluate ROOT.parent.parent in canonical and vendored layouts and compare the release package inventory with fault-injection/scenarios.json.
hypotheses.observed_result: Canonical layout resolves to the repository root containing fault-injection/scenarios.json; consumer layout resolves to .agents/. The fixture is not in the 2.11.2 package tree, yet the retained package test requires it.

correction: Make all released package regressions self-contained: package any fixture required by package tests and resolve it from the package root, or replace the test dependency with a package-contained equivalent. Add a clean vendored-layout regression that runs the complete package test suite without canonical-repository files outside the package.
defense_in_depth: Extend release/consumer validation so at least one archived consumer executes the full vendored package suite in a layout containing no canonical repo-root fixtures; fail release validation on any package test that reaches outside the package boundary for required data.
invariant: A released CDC package that passes its package validator must carry every non-generated fixture required to execute its retained package test suite in a consumer vendored layout; package tests must not require canonical-repository files outside the released package tree.
